steps.title: Review active work permits
steps.instruction: Confirm no conflicting work orders on Pump 7A. Notify supervisor if any are open.
steps.hint: Check the permit board or CMMS before proceeding.

steps.title: Notify affected personnel
steps.instruction: Inform operators that Pump 7A will be locked out.

steps.title: Locate main disconnect
steps.instruction: Stand beside the disconnect. Place the arrow on the floor next to the real panel.
steps.hint: Wrong disconnect is a top LOTO failure mode.

placement.prompt: Point at the floor beside the disconnect. When the blue ring shows, tap Place on floor.

steps.title: Open disconnect
steps.instruction: Switch disconnect to OFF. Mark the work zone on the floor in front of the panel.

placement.prompt: Place the orange ring on the floor where you will stand to operate the disconnect.

steps.title: Apply lock and tag
steps.instruction: Apply your personal lock and tag. Place the pad on the floor where the lock should be applied.
steps.hint: One person, one lock, one key.

placement.prompt: Place the blue pad on the floor beside the lock point on the real equipment.

steps.title: Verify zero energy
steps.instruction: Attempt a normal restart from the control station (should not start). Record result.

steps.title: Session complete
steps.instruction: LOTO placement verified. Do not remove locks until your work is complete and approved.
